title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - governed-knowledge operations
description: Provider-neutral wire shapes for the explicit governed-knowledge search and governance-transition operations: `knowledge.search`, `knowledge.propose`, `candidate.approve`, `candidate.reject`, and `record.supersede` (ADR-039). Every operation is workspace-scoped through the request envelope and never carries a second, independent workspace identifier. Every mutation input identifies its target record by `record_id` only: the target *version* is the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`, never duplicated here. No mutation input carries a governance-state, currentness, authority-level, reviewer identity, or server-owned temporal field; every governance decision is produced server-side from an explicit, auditable `GovernanceRationale`, never smuggled through an automated-extraction input. This document declares no root type; it is a definition container only.

GovernanceRationale.title: GovernanceRationale
GovernanceRationale.description: A caller-supplied, auditable reason for a governance decision or transition: an open reason code plus an optional bounded human-readable comment. Carries no reviewer identity, authority level, or governance-state field of its own -- those are server-owned and never asserted through this shape.

reason_code.description: Open code naming why this governance decision or transition was made.

comment.description: Optional bounded human-readable elaboration. Not a stable interface.

KnowledgeSearchInput.title: KnowledgeSearchInput
KnowledgeSearchInput.description: Input for `knowledge.search`. Workspace-scoped: the workspace is the request envelope's selected workspace; this payload never carries a second, independent workspace identifier. Absent `view` defaults to `current_canonical`; only an explicit `view` selector may request `candidates` or `history`, so a caller can never receive candidate, rejected, superseded, or otherwise non-canonical governed knowledge by omission.

order.description: Requested result order. Absent means the server's default order.

view.description: Which slice of records' versions to consider. Absent defaults to `current_canonical`; requesting `candidates` or `history` requires this field to be set explicitly.

record_type.description: Restrict results to this record type, when set.

domain_scope.description: Restrict results to this domain scope, when set.

limit.description: Bounded maximum number of records to return in this page.

page.description: Continuation position from a prior page, when paging.

KnowledgeSearchResult.title: KnowledgeSearchResult
KnowledgeSearchResult.description: Result of `knowledge.search`. When the request's `view` was absent or `current_canonical`, every returned record must be the exact accepted, current, canonical version; no candidate, rejected, superseded, or non-canonical-layer record may appear.

records.description: Governed records in this page, ordered per the request's `order`.

page.description: Continuation position for the next page, absent on the last page.

KnowledgeProposeInput.title: KnowledgeProposeInput
KnowledgeProposeInput.description: Input for `knowledge.propose`: transitions an existing proposed (`l1`/`proposed`) record into a candidate (`l1`/`candidate`) awaiting a governance decision. Never duplicates `memory.create`: it identifies an already-existing record by `record_id` rather than proposing new content, and never carries content, evidence, or assertion fields. The target version is the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`, not duplicated here. Like every other governance transition, the rationale is required: no governance decision on this contract is ever recorded without an explicit, auditable reason.

record_id.description: Identifier of the existing proposed record to transition into a candidate.

rationale.description: Reason this record is being put forward as a candidate.

KnowledgeProposeResult.title: KnowledgeProposeResult
KnowledgeProposeResult.description: Result of `knowledge.propose`: both versions of the record as they stand *after* the transition, so a caller can validate the transition and confirm no history or provenance was lost. `previous_record` is the prior version, which the transition has itself marked superseded and pointed at the new one; `updated_record` is the newly current version. Neither is a pre-transition snapshot: `previous_record` is what that version now is, not what it looked like before the call.

previous_record.description: The prior version this transition replaced, as it stands after the transition: still carrying its own `proposed` claim, now marked superseded and pointing at `updated_record`.

updated_record.description: The newly current version: the record's new candidate state.

CandidateApproveInput.title: CandidateApproveInput
CandidateApproveInput.description: Input for `candidate.approve`: creates a new accepted (`l2`/`accepted`) governed version of an existing candidate record, with reviewer authority attributed server-side. The target version is the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`, not duplicated here. Carries no authority-level, reviewer identity, or governance-state field of its own -- only the explicit, auditable rationale for the decision.

record_id.description: Identifier of the candidate record to approve.

CandidateApproveResult.title: CandidateApproveResult
CandidateApproveResult.description: Result of `candidate.approve`: both versions of the record as they stand *after* approval, so a caller can validate the transition and confirm no history or provenance was lost. `previous_record` is the prior candidate version, which the approval has itself marked superseded and pointed at the new one; `updated_record` is the newly current version. Neither is a pre-transition snapshot: `previous_record` is what that version now is, not what it looked like before the call.

previous_record.description: The prior candidate version this approval replaced, as it stands after the transition: still carrying its candidate authority, now marked superseded and pointing at `updated_record`.

updated_record.description: The newly current version: the record's new accepted, current, canonical state.

CandidateRejectInput.title: CandidateRejectInput
CandidateRejectInput.description: Input for `candidate.reject`: creates a new rejected (`l1`/`rejected`) governed version of an existing candidate record, with reviewer authority attributed server-side. The target version is the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`, not duplicated here. `rejected` is never treated as a favourable or accepted authority decision.

record_id.description: Identifier of the candidate record to reject.

CandidateRejectResult.title: CandidateRejectResult
CandidateRejectResult.description: Result of `candidate.reject`: both versions of the record as they stand *after* rejection, so a caller can validate the transition and confirm no history or provenance was lost. `previous_record` is the prior candidate version, which the rejection has itself marked superseded and pointed at the new one; `updated_record` is the newly current version. Neither is a pre-transition snapshot: `previous_record` is what that version now is, not what it looked like before the call.

previous_record.description: The prior candidate version this rejection replaced, as it stands after the transition: still carrying its candidate authority, now marked superseded and pointing at `updated_record`.

updated_record.description: The newly current version: the record's new rejected state. `rejected` carries a reviewer, but is never a favourable or accepted authority decision.

RecordSupersedeInput.title: RecordSupersedeInput
RecordSupersedeInput.description: Input for `record.supersede`: an explicit, authorized replacement of a current accepted (`l2`/`accepted`/`current`) governed record with a new accepted version. The target version is the envelope's `MutationPrecondition.record_version`, not duplicated here. Exactly three fields: which record, the complete replacement claim, and why. The replacement is a whole `MemoryCreateInput` rather than a loose bag of content/evidence fields, so the new version's content, evidence disposition, sources, assertion, extraction lineage, and proposed validity window are supplied and validated as one coherent claim under exactly the rules `memory.create` already enforces. It inherits that shape's least-authority-escalating guarantee: no governance-state, currentness, authority-level, reviewer, or supersession field is accepted from a caller. The server alone produces the new version's identity, authority, temporal envelope, and the reciprocal `supersedes`/`superseded_by` pointers, and the replacement's `record_type`/`domain_scope` must equal the superseded record's -- superseding replaces a claim, it never silently reclassifies the record.

record_id.description: Identifier of the current accepted record to supersede.

replacement.description: The complete replacement claim: content, evidence disposition, sources, assertion, optional extraction lineage, and optional event/observed times, in exactly the shape `memory.create` accepts. Its `record_type`/`domain_scope` must equal the superseded record's.

rationale.description: Reason this record is being superseded.

RecordSupersedeResult.title: RecordSupersedeResult
RecordSupersedeResult.description: Result of `record.supersede`: the prior current record (now superseded) and the new current record, so a caller can validate the reciprocal `supersedes`/`superseded_by` pointers, the preserved stable record identity, and the complete, unerased provenance history.

previous_record.description: The prior current record, now superseded.

updated_record.description: The new current, accepted, canonical record.

CandidateDecisionGetInput.title: CandidateDecisionGetInput
CandidateDecisionGetInput.description: Input for `candidate.decision.get`: the one workspace-scoped governed record whose latest governance decision is read back. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace; a record of another workspace is indistinguishable from an unknown one.

record_id.description: Identifier of the governed record whose latest decision is read.

CandidateDecisionGetResult.title: CandidateDecisionGetResult
CandidateDecisionGetResult.description: Result of `candidate.decision.get`: the latest governance decision metadata of one governed record and nothing else. It carries no record content, no rejected-candidate content, no rationale text and no earlier history, and it never widens what the canonical-only `memory.get` views serve.

record_id.description: The governed record this result describes.

version.description: The latest governed version of the record, whichever governance state it is in.

governance_state.description: The state the latest governance act left the record in: `proposed` (a candidate with no decision), `accepted` (approved), `rejected`, or `superseded` (an accepted record later corrected by a replacement).

decision_actor_id.description: The principal that took the latest decision, as the server authenticated it. Absent while the record is `proposed`, because nothing has yet been decided.

decision_actor_kind.description: Open code naming the kind of that principal, such as `user`. Present exactly when `decision_actor_id` is.

decided_at.description: When Core recorded the latest decision. Present exactly when `decision_actor_id` is.

KnowledgeShareDecision.title: KnowledgeShareDecision
KnowledgeShareDecision.description: The two owner decisions a knowledge share can carry: `accepted` makes the share eligible for its recipient Project, and `revoked` withdraws that eligibility for every later read. Closed: no third decision exists, and a revocation is only recorded against a share that was accepted.

KnowledgeShareState.title: KnowledgeShareState
KnowledgeShareState.description: Where one knowledge share stands, derived from its decisions on every read and never stored as a flag. `proposed` has no decision and grants its recipient nothing, `accepted` is eligible, and `revoked` was accepted and is no longer eligible.

KnowledgeShareDecisionRecord.title: KnowledgeShareDecisionRecord
KnowledgeShareDecisionRecord.description: One decision recorded against a share, kept after a later revocation so a source owner can still read how the share was authorised.

decided_by.description: The principal that recorded the decision, as the server authenticated it.

KnowledgeShareProposeInput.title: KnowledgeShareProposeInput
KnowledgeShareProposeInput.description: Input for `knowledge.share.propose`. An owner of the Project that holds a governed record proposes sharing that record's current sealed, canonical version with one other Project. The source Project is never stated here: the server derives it from the record's own domain scope and the Project bindings it holds, and refuses a caller that is not a bound owner of that Project. Naming a recipient grants nothing; the share is eligible only after a different owner accepts it. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace.

share_id.description: The caller-chosen identity of this share. Proposing the same share again under the same identity is an honest replay; a different proposal under it is a conflict.

record_id.description: The governed record whose current canonical version is proposed for sharing.

recipient_project_id.description: The Project the share is addressed to. It must be a Project the server binds, and it must not be the source Project.

KnowledgeShareProposeResult.title: KnowledgeShareProposeResult
KnowledgeShareProposeResult.description: Result of `knowledge.share.propose`: the share as recorded, still `proposed`. A replay under the same idempotency key returns this result without a second write.

source_project_id.description: The Project that owns the shared record, as the server's Project binding states it.

recipient_project_id.description: The one Project the share is addressed to.

governed_record_version_id.description: The one sealed, canonical, accepted governed version the share is bound to.

content_digest.description: The digest of that version's content, which a recipient read must still find unchanged.

state.description: Always `proposed` on this result: proposing grants the recipient nothing.

KnowledgeShareDecideInput.title: KnowledgeShareDecideInput
KnowledgeShareDecideInput.description: Input for `knowledge.share.decide`. An owner of the share's source Project accepts it or revokes it. An acceptance must come from an owner other than the proposer and only while the shared version is still sealed, canonical, accepted and unsuperseded; a revocation is only recorded against an accepted share. The source Project is read from the share, never from this payload. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace.

decision.description: Whether to accept or revoke the share.

KnowledgeShareDecideResult.title: KnowledgeShareDecideResult
KnowledgeShareDecideResult.description: Result of `knowledge.share.decide`: the decision as recorded and the state the share now holds. A replay under the same idempotency key returns this result without a second write.

state.description: The state the share holds after the decision.

KnowledgeShareReadInput.title: KnowledgeShareReadInput
KnowledgeShareReadInput.description: Input for `knowledge.share.read`. A member of the recipient Project reads the one governed version a share makes eligible. The recipient Project is never stated here: the server reads it from the share and requires the caller to be bound to it. Possessing a share identifier, holding a broad knowledge-read grant, belonging to the workspace, or having read the share before confers nothing: eligibility is re-derived from the accepted and revoked decisions and the shared version's currentness on every call. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace.

KnowledgeShareReadResult.title: KnowledgeShareReadResult
KnowledgeShareReadResult.description: Result of `knowledge.share.read`: the shared version's identity, its digest and its content, served only while the share is accepted, unrevoked and still points at the sealed version it was proposed under.

source_project_id.description: The Project that owns the shared record, as the server's Project binding states it.

recipient_project_id.description: The one Project the share is addressed to.

governed_record_version_id.description: The one sealed, canonical, accepted governed version the share is bound to.

content_digest.description: The digest of that version's content, which a recipient read must still find unchanged.

domain_scope.description: The domain scope the shared record was created in, which the source Project's binding must still own.

content.description: The sealed version's content, exactly as the governed record holds it; `content_digest` is the digest of this content.

KnowledgeShareLineageInput.title: KnowledgeShareLineageInput
KnowledgeShareLineageInput.description: Input for `knowledge.share.lineage`. An owner of the share's source Project reads the share and every decision recorded against it, revoked ones included. Historical lineage stays readable after revocation. A recipient is not a source owner and cannot read it. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace.

share_id.description: The share whose lineage is read.

KnowledgeShareLineageResult.title: KnowledgeShareLineageResult
KnowledgeShareLineageResult.description: Result of `knowledge.share.lineage`: the share, the state its decisions currently derive, and every decision in the order it was recorded.

source_project_id.description: The Project that owns the shared record, as the server's Project binding states it.

recipient_project_id.description: The one Project the share is addressed to.

governed_record_version_id.description: The one sealed, canonical, accepted governed version the share is bound to.

content_digest.description: The digest of that version's content, which a recipient read must still find unchanged.

state.description: The state the recorded decisions derive.

proposed_by.description: The principal that proposed the share.

decisions.description: Every decision recorded against the share, accepted and revoked, in the order recorded.

KnowledgeEvaluationContent.title: KnowledgeEvaluationContent
KnowledgeEvaluationContent.description: One caller-held Stage 2 content object (the candidate overlay, the evaluation suite, a case, an attempt or a worker binding) exactly as its governed-knowledge profile states it. Core validates the shape and derives every status, total, finding and digest from it; a caller-supplied derived field is refused by the producer.

KnowledgeEvaluationSource.title: KnowledgeEvaluationSource
KnowledgeEvaluationSource.description: The source the evaluated material came from, as the evidence ledger's source record states it. `locator` is a pointer and never content, and its prefix must match `locator_scheme`. Core derives every evidence and content reference from this source and the report, so the caller names none of them.

source_id.description: The caller-chosen identity of the source. Reusing it for a different locator or version is a conflict.

locator.description: The pointer to the source. It must start with `urn:`, `file:` or `https:` when the scheme says so.

version.description: The version of the source the evaluation was run against.

KnowledgeEvaluationProduceInput.title: KnowledgeEvaluationProduceInput
KnowledgeEvaluationProduceInput.description: Input for `knowledge.evaluation.produce`. The caller submits the exact Stage 2 content it holds (the overlay, the suite, its cases, the evaluation attempts and their worker bindings) and the identifiers and classification the evidence ledger needs. Core derives the evaluation report, its status, coverage, findings and integrity digest from that content and never accepts them. The caller states no verdict. The request principal attests that these attempts were submitted; Core does not claim it observed any external model output. Workspace-scoped through the request envelope's selected workspace.

suite.description: The evaluation suite the cases belong to.

cases.description: The suite's cases, in the suite's own order.

attempts.description: The evaluation attempts submitted as evidence. At least one is required.

worker_bindings.description: The worker bindings, which must be exactly those the attempts reference.

report_id.description: The caller-chosen identity of the evaluation report.

triggering_case_ref.description: The case that triggered this evaluation.

classification.description: The data classification of the report and its evidence: `public`, `internal`, `confidential` or `restricted`.

retention_class.description: The retention class the report and its evidence are kept under.

source.description: The source the evaluated material came from.

KnowledgeEvaluationEvidenceRecord.title: KnowledgeEvaluationEvidenceRecord
KnowledgeEvaluationEvidenceRecord.description: One canonical record registered in the evidence ledger by a produce call: its deterministic evidence identity, the record it stands for, and the checksum of that record's canonical content.

evidence_id.description: The evidence identity Core assigned to this record.

record_kind.description: The canonical record kind, such as `evaluation_attempt` or `evaluation_report`.

record_id.description: The identity the record carries in its own canonical content.

content_digest.description: The checksum of the record's canonical content, exactly as the evidence ledger stores it.

KnowledgeEvaluationProduceResult.title: KnowledgeEvaluationProduceResult
KnowledgeEvaluationProduceResult.description: Result of `knowledge.evaluation.produce`: the report Core derived from the submitted content, the authenticated principal that submitted it, and every evidence record registered for it. A replay under the same idempotency key returns this result without a second write.

report.description: The derived evaluation report content, including its status, coverage, findings and integrity digest.

submitted_by.description: The principal that submitted the attempts, as the server authenticated it.

evidence.description: Every canonical record registered, in the producer's record order.

TaskContextExportInput.title: TaskContextExportInput
TaskContextExportInput.description: Input for `task_context.export`. The caller hands over one assembled task-context handoff and the explicit budgets the export must fit. The handoff is data: Core verifies its recorded identity against its content and projects one fixed set of content sections under Core's redaction patterns. The workspace, the exporting principal, the fencing generation and the policy are the server's own and are never stated here. An export is never truncated: a handoff that does not fit its budgets is refused.

handoff.description: The assembled task-context handoff, carried verbatim as data. It must be in the closed handoff shape and recompute to its own recorded content identity.

token_budget.description: The explicit token budget the export must fit, under the `utf8-ceil4-v1` estimator.

byte_budget.description: The explicit byte budget the canonical export document must fit.

TaskContextExportResult.title: TaskContextExportResult
TaskContextExportResult.description: Result of `task_context.export`: one immutable export as recorded. `export_id` names exactly the canonical document carried in `document`, so the identity can be checked by any holder of the result. A replay under the same idempotency key returns this result without a second write.

export_id.description: The export's identity: the prefix `tcx-` and the SHA-256 of its canonical document.

source_handoff_identity.description: The content identity of the handoff this export projects, as the handoff recorded and Core recomputed it.

exported_by.description: The principal that made the export, as the authenticated caller.

policy_digest.description: The digest of the one export policy this build serves.

fencing_generation.description: The workspace fencing generation the export was recorded under.

token_budget.description: The token budget the export was checked against.

byte_budget.description: The byte budget the export was checked against.

token_estimate.description: The token estimate of the canonical document, under `utf8-ceil4-v1`.

byte_estimate.description: The byte length of the canonical document.

document.description: The canonical export document: the allowlisted content sections after redaction, the withheld field names and the redaction counts.

TaskContextExportReadInput.title: TaskContextExportReadInput
TaskContextExportReadInput.description: Input for `task_context.export.read`. The caller names one export by its identifier and nothing else. The workspace is the request envelope's selected workspace, and an export recorded in another workspace reads as not found.

OutcomeRequestCreateInput.title: OutcomeRequestCreateInput
OutcomeRequestCreateInput.description: Input for `outcome.request.create`. The caller asks for an outcome against one stored task-context export, carrying a bounded natural-language objective verbatim. The export is named by identifier only. The workspace and the requesting principal are the authenticated caller's, and the export must be in this workspace, recorded under the current fencing generation and produced under the policy this build serves.

objective.description: The objective, kept verbatim. It must not be empty and must fit the Core byte bound.

export_id.description: The export this request is made against.

admission.description: Optional structured admission. Absent for a legacy request. When present, it is one closed reviewed summary and its claimed identity, and Core admits the request only if every declared fact holds at the time of the request.

OutcomeRequestReadInput.title: OutcomeRequestReadInput
OutcomeRequestReadInput.description: Input for `outcome.request.read`. The caller names one outcome request by its identifier and nothing else. A request recorded in another workspace reads as not found.

TaskContextExportReadResult.title: TaskContextExportReadResult
TaskContextExportReadResult.description: Result of `task_context.export.read`: one immutable export as recorded, read back by its identifier. Its identity is re-derived from the stored document before it is served.

export_id.description: The export's identity: the prefix `tcx-` and the SHA-256 of its canonical document.

source_handoff_identity.description: The content identity of the handoff this export projects, as the handoff recorded and Core recomputed it.

exported_by.description: The principal that made the export, as the authenticated caller.

policy_digest.description: The digest of the one export policy this build serves.

fencing_generation.description: The workspace fencing generation the export was recorded under.

token_budget.description: The token budget the export was checked against.

byte_budget.description: The byte budget the export was checked against.

token_estimate.description: The token estimate of the canonical document, under `utf8-ceil4-v1`.

byte_estimate.description: The byte length of the canonical document.

document.description: The canonical export document: the allowlisted content sections after redaction, the withheld field names and the redaction counts.

OutcomeRequestCreateResult.title: OutcomeRequestCreateResult
OutcomeRequestCreateResult.description: Result of `outcome.request.create`: one received outcome request as recorded. A replay under the same idempotency key returns this result without a second write.

outcome_request_id.description: The request's identity: the prefix `outreq-` and the SHA-256 of its canonical body.

source_handoff_identity.description: The source handoff identity the named export records.

requested_by.description: The principal that made the request, as the authenticated caller.

status.description: Where the request stands. `received` is the only value this build records.

fencing_generation.description: The workspace fencing generation the request was recorded under.

admission.description: The admission this request was accepted under. Absent for a legacy request.

context_generation.description: The active Project context generation the admission was accepted under. Absent for a legacy request.

OutcomeRequestReadResult.title: OutcomeRequestReadResult
OutcomeRequestReadResult.description: Result of `outcome.request.read`: one received outcome request as recorded, re-derived from its stored fields before it is served.

outcome_request_id.description: The request's identity: the prefix `outreq-` and the SHA-256 of its canonical body.

source_handoff_identity.description: The source handoff identity the named export records.

requested_by.description: The principal that made the request, as the authenticated caller.

status.description: Where the request stands. `received` is the only value this build records.

fencing_generation.description: The workspace fencing generation the request was recorded under.

admission.description: The admission this request was accepted under. Absent for a legacy request.

context_generation.description: The active Project context generation the admission was accepted under. Absent for a legacy request.

ProjectContextToken.title: ProjectContextToken
ProjectContextToken.description: The opaque token naming one Workspace's active Project context generation: the prefix `ctxgen-` and a positive integer. Callers compare it for equality and never derive meaning from it.

ProjectContextStateKind.title: ProjectContextStateKind
ProjectContextStateKind.description: The closed state of a Workspace's active Project context: `none` when no Project is active, `active` when one is.

ProjectContextReadResult.title: ProjectContextReadResult
ProjectContextReadResult.description: Result of `project.context.read` and `project.context.switch`: the Workspace's active Core Project and its opaque context generation, or the typed empty state `none` when no Project is active. `project_id` and `context_generation` are present only with state `active`.

state.description: Whether a Project is active in this Workspace.

project_id.description: The active Core Project. Present only when a Project is active.

context_generation.description: The opaque generation of the active Project context. Present only when a Project is active.

ProjectContextSwitchResult.title: ProjectContextSwitchResult
ProjectContextSwitchResult.description: Result of `project.context.read` and `project.context.switch`: the Workspace's active Core Project and its opaque context generation, or the typed empty state `none` when no Project is active. `project_id` and `context_generation` are present only with state `active`.

state.description: Whether a Project is active in this Workspace.

project_id.description: The active Core Project. Present only when a Project is active.

context_generation.description: The opaque generation of the active Project context. Present only when a Project is active.

ProjectContextReadInput.title: ProjectContextReadInput
ProjectContextReadInput.description: Input for `project.context.read`. The caller names nothing: the Workspace and the principal are the authenticated caller's, and the read observes the active Project context without changing it.

ProjectContextSwitchInput.title: ProjectContextSwitchInput
ProjectContextSwitchInput.description: Input for `project.context.switch`. The caller names the Core Project to make active in the authenticated Workspace and nothing else. The Project must be bound for this Workspace and the authenticated principal must be one of its owners or members.

project_id.description: The Core Project to make active.

AdmissionRevision.title: AdmissionRevision
AdmissionRevision.description: The revision of the reviewed admission summary. It is the positive integer that identity covers. Any integer below 1 is refused.

AdmissionScope.title: AdmissionScope
AdmissionScope.description: One requested scope of an admitted outcome, from the closed vocabulary Core defines.

AdmissionAdapter.title: AdmissionAdapter
AdmissionAdapter.description: The adapter that produced the summary. Only `dev-task-admission` is accepted.

AdmissionDisposition.title: AdmissionDisposition
AdmissionDisposition.description: The disposition of a summary: it is a draft for review, never an accepted outcome.

AdmissionExecutionState.title: AdmissionExecutionState
AdmissionExecutionState.description: The execution state of a summary. A summary never authorizes execution.

AdmissionBindingStatus.title: AdmissionBindingStatus
AdmissionBindingStatus.description: The status of the declared bindings. Dev declares them and does not verify them; Core checks them itself.

AdmissionScopeStatus.title: AdmissionScopeStatus
AdmissionScopeStatus.description: The status of the requested scopes. A summary requests scopes and grants none.

AdmissionRoleStatus.title: AdmissionRoleStatus
AdmissionRoleStatus.description: The status of the declared roles. They are claims and never authenticate the caller.

AdmissionTokenEstimator.title: AdmissionTokenEstimator
AdmissionTokenEstimator.description: The token estimator the budgets are sized with: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4).

AdmissionAppContext.title: AdmissionAppContext
AdmissionAppContext.description: The typed initiating App context of an admission: which App asked for the outcome, and from which surface.

surfaceId.description: The App surface the outcome was requested from.

AdmissionDeclaredBindings.title: AdmissionDeclaredBindings
AdmissionDeclaredBindings.description: The Project, Workspace, Work and source facts a summary declares. Declared, not verified: Core checks each one against its own bindings before it admits anything.

projectId.description: The Core Project the outcome is made for.

workspaceId.description: The Workspace the outcome belongs to. It must be the authenticated caller's Workspace.

sourceTarget.description: The source target the Work reads from. Opaque to Core, and bound by the Project's admission bindings.

sourceRevision.description: The immutable revision of the source target the Work reads.

expectedContextGeneration.description: The Project context generation the summary was reviewed against. It must equal the active generation.

AdmissionRoles.title: AdmissionRoles
AdmissionRoles.description: The three accountable principals a summary declares. Each is a claim that Core checks against the Project's bindings. None is an identity for the caller.

owner.description: The accountable owner declared for the outcome.

executor.description: The accountable executor declared for the outcome.

reviewer.description: The accountable reviewer declared for the outcome.

AdmissionBudgets.title: AdmissionBudgets
AdmissionBudgets.description: The explicit budgets of an admission and the estimator they are sized with. The serialized summary must fit both.

tokenBudget.description: The token budget for the outcome.

byteBudget.description: The byte budget for the outcome.

AdmissionIdentity.title: AdmissionIdentity
AdmissionIdentity.description: The canonical identity of an admission summary: the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the summary's canonical JSON.

OutcomeAdmissionSummary.title: OutcomeAdmissionSummary
OutcomeAdmissionSummary.description: One reviewed, canonical summary of an outcome admission, in the closed shape Dev produces: the revision, the fixed status labels, the objective, the initiating App, the declared bindings and roles, the assumptions, constraints, requested scopes (in ascending order) and budgets. Dev grants no authority; Core admits it only against its own bindings.

revision.description: The summary revision, a positive integer.

outcomeObjective.description: The objective, which must equal the request's top-level objective.

appContext.description: The App that initiated the outcome, and its surface.

declaredBindings.description: The declared Project, Workspace, Work and source facts.

declaredRoles.description: The declared owner, executor and reviewer.

assumptions.description: The assumptions the summary rests on, in the order given. Items are non-blank, and their total UTF-8 size with the constraints is bounded.

constraints.description: The constraints the outcome must respect, in the order given. Items are non-blank, and their total UTF-8 size with the assumptions is bounded.

requestedScopes.description: The requested scopes, distinct and in ascending order.

budgets.description: The explicit budgets and their estimator.

OutcomeAdmission.title: OutcomeAdmission
OutcomeAdmission.description: A structured outcome admission: one closed reviewed summary and the identity the caller claims for it. Core recomputes the identity from the summary and refuses a mismatch.

identity.description: The claimed canonical identity of the summary.
